notes.title: Notice of Release Postponement
notes.content:
We had planned to launch by the end of 2024, but
We have changed the release date to next year, 2025.

Although the number of stages we have created is well over 5 times that of the demo version
We still have a lot of work to do and it will be difficult to release by the end of this year.

We will continue to work hard to complete and release the game next year.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Attend the Steam Next fest(October ) & add about the demo ver.
notes.content:
This title is scheduled to participate in the Steam Next fest in October!

The end date of the release of the demo version has not yet been determined.
We will make a new announcement when it will end.

About the contents of the demo version
You can play 1 side (demo scene + training + 5 battles) and special battles.
Saved data cannot be carried over to the final version.
This is a demo version created from data under development, and specifications may differ from the final version.

In the special battle, you can fight a boss that will appear in the second half of the game.
The boss is a little weakened because it appeared too early, but it is a much stronger enemy than the one on the first page.

The game can be played with a controller (X-input) or a keyboard.
If the controller does not work properly, switching ON/OFF the SteamInput  may return to normal operation.
